s1.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness with cardiac arrhythmia
salient_findings: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min
key_facts: Presented to the emergency department during the COVID-19 pandemic
Cardiac auscultation: Regular rate and rhythm without murmurs, rubs, or gallops
Pulmonary auscultation: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness with cardiac arrhythmia
salient_findings: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min
key_facts: Presented to the emergency department during the COVID-19 pandemic
Cardiac auscultation: Regular rate and rhythm without murmurs, rubs, or gallops
Pulmonary auscultation: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs

differentials: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia with a RyR2 mutation
per_call: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia with a RyR2 mutation

shortlist.label: Atrial tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min

shortlist.label: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Long RP interval and short P-wave duration

shortlist.label: Paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Palpitations and tachycardia in a patient without prior arrhythmia history

shortlist.label: COVID-19 associated myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive SARS-CoV-2 PCR test and mild diastolic dysfunction on echocardiogram

shortlist.label: Pulmonary embolism
shortlist.why_kept: Shortness of breath, cough, and inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs

raw.rationale: The ECG findings of a regular, narrow complex tachycardia with a rate of 170 beats/min, superiorly directed P waves, and a long RP interval are consistent with atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT). The short P-wave duration and the termination of T waves with a negative deflection corresponding to the P wave in lead V1 also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Atrial tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG does not show evidence of atrial enlargement or abnormal P-wave morphology typical of atrial tachycardia.

rejected.label: Paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
rejected.why: While paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (PSVT) is a broad term that includes AVNRT, the specific ECG characteristics point more directly to AVNRT as the cause of the tachycardia.

rejected.label: COVID-19 associated myocarditis
rejected.why: Myocarditis could explain the presentation, but the specific ECG findings and the lack of other indicators of myocarditis (such as elevated troponins or significant echocardiogram abnormalities beyond mild diastolic dysfunction) make AVNRT a more direct explanation for the tachycardia.

rejected.label: Pulmonary embolism
rejected.why: While the patient has respiratory symptoms and COVID-19, which can increase the risk of pulmonary embolism, the ECG findings are not typical for a pulmonary embolism, and there's no mention of other diagnostic evidence like D-dimer levels or imaging findings suggestive of a pulmonary embolism.
